info.name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Get Single Series Data

params.name: seriesId
params.description: A single BLS series ID (e.g., LAUCN040010000000005 for local area unemployment, CUUR0000SA0 for CPI All Urban Consumers).

params.name: startyear
params.description: First year of data to retrieve in YYYY format.

params.name: endyear
params.description: Last year of data to retrieve in YYYY format.

params.name: registrationkey
params.description: BLS API registration key obtained from data.bls.gov/registrationEngine/. Required for Version 2 features such as catalog, calculations, and annual averages.

params.name: catalog
params.description: Set to true to include series catalog metadata in the response.

params.name: calculations
params.description: Set to true to include net and percent change calculations.

params.name: annualaverage
params.description: Set to true to include annual averages in the response.

params.name: aspects
params.description: Set to true to include aspects metadata for the series.

items.docs: Retrieve time series data for a single BLS series ID. Returns historical data points including year, period, and value. Optional parameters allow filtering by year range and requesting additional metadata.

info.name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Get Multiple Series Data

items.docs: Retrieve time series data for one or more BLS series IDs in a single request. Version 2 supports up to 50 series per request and up to 20 years of data. Version 1 supports up to 25 series and fewer features.

info.name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Get Popular Series

params.name: survey
params.description: Survey abbreviation to filter popular series (e.g., CPS for Current Population Survey, CES for Current Employment Statistics).

items.docs: Retrieve the 25 most popular BLS series IDs. Can optionally specify a survey abbreviation to get popular series for a specific survey.
